infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Safe Route AI uses your location to attach an accurate position to threat reports, to alert you when a verified threat is near you, and to broadcast your position during an SOS.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location lets Safe Route AI keep broadcasting your position to your security officers while an SOS is active.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Attach a photo to a threat report so officers can verify it faster.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach an existing photo to a threat report.

web.//: Single-page output, not static. Every route is behind an auth gate, so at build time there is no session and pre-rendering produces empty shells. This app is also deliberately not indexed - it is an authenticated tool for named field staff - so SSG buys nothing.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Safe Route AI broadcasts your live position to your security officers while an SOS is active.

plugins.photosPermission: Attach a photo to a threat report so officers can verify it faster.
plugins.cameraPermission: Take a photo of the incident to attach to your report.
